prompt: A coding agent that works for hours keeps a todo and progress file it updates and re-reads after each context reset.
why: External notes carry state across windows.
trap: Compaction summarizes; notes are deliberately written state.

prompt: An agent playing a long game tracks which areas it has explored and its current goal in a notes file, so it doesn't loop.
tells: tracks which areas it has explored
why: Structured notes keep long-horizon tasks on track.
trap: The game is just the setting; the technique is external memory.

prompt: Before coding, the agent writes a JSON list of features with a pass/fail field and updates it as it goes.
why: A structured state file is easy to re-read and hard to accidentally rewrite.
trap: It's notes, not a spec: it tracks progress.

prompt: Each new session re-debates choices settled yesterday because nobody wrote them down where the agent can read them.
why: Keep a decisions file the agent reads at the start.
trap: Summaries die with the session; files don't.
